title: Northbeam TechWorks Recovery: The Rate a Rebilled Line Is Charged At
content:
The rate a rebilled line on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is charged at is read from the labour of the day the crew was dispatched, and in two situations is replaced.

- Where the labour of the day the crew was dispatched was recorded at any rate other than the service's own hourly rate, the service's own hourly rate is the rate.
- Where that labour was recorded at the service's own rate, the slot for the work stood in the evening and no out-of-hours surcharge stands booked on the job, the service's own hourly rate raised by its after-hours surcharge percent is the rate.
- Where neither situation holds, the rate is the rate recorded on the labour of the day the crew was dispatched.

Where such a surcharge does stand booked on the job the rate is not raised, so the same hour never carries the surcharge twice.

## The readings side by side

| The rate that labour was recorded at | The slot for the work | An out-of-hours surcharge stands booked on the job | The rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| other than the service's own hourly rate | any | either | the service's own hourly rate |
| the service's own hourly rate | the evening | none | the service's own hourly rate raised by its after-hours surcharge percent |
| the service's own hourly rate | the evening | at least one | the rate recorded on that labour |
| the service's own hourly rate | a window other than the evening | either | the rate recorded on that labour |

The first line governs whatever the window and whatever surcharge stands on the job: where the recorded rate differs from the service's own, the service's own rate is taken and no raising follows.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The rates below are chosen for the illustration and are not those recorded on any job on file.*

Take a hypothetical job under TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration, whose own hourly rate is 159.00 USD an hour and whose after-hours surcharge percent is 35.

**The service's own rate, an afternoon slot.** Neither situation holds, and the rate stands at the 159.00 USD an hour recorded on that labour.

**The service's own rate, an evening slot, a surcharge already booked.** The rate is not raised and stands at the 159.00 USD an hour recorded on that labour.

**The service's own rate, an evening slot, no surcharge on the job.** The rate is 159.00 raised by 35 percent, which is 214.65 USD an hour.

**An unusual recorded rate.** The labour of the day the crew was dispatched was recorded at 132.50 USD an hour. The rate is the service's own, 159.00 USD an hour.
